title: Tool entry
description: Editor hint only. The authoritative checks (including product, type and tag names) are in build/build.py.

tags.description: Each tag must exist in build/config/tags.json (checked by build.py, not by this schema).

update_source.description: How check_updates.py dates a GitHub tool. 'commit' = latest commit (on the repo, or on the folder for a /tree/ URL); never reads releases or sets version. 'release' = repo's latest release. Default: release for a plain repo URL (falling back to tag, then commit), commit for a /tree/ or /blob/ URL.

release_tag_prefix.description: Only consider releases whose tag starts with this (e.g. 'tool-a/') when check_updates.py looks up the version, for monorepos that tag each component. Implies update_source 'release'; the prefix is removed from the version. Not allowed with update_source 'commit'.

archived.description: Hide from the default listing. Shown only when the Archived filter is set to Include or Only.

archived_reason.description: Why it was archived (shown to users). Only allowed when archived is true.

featured.description: Show in the Featured band at the top of the website's default view. Not allowed on archived tools.

added.description: Optional override. Normally recorded automatically in build/config/added.json.
